runtime_boundary: Game build 25290080 (2026-10 update + Dark Arisen DLC), REFramework nightly 01424. The user ran PicodraTech up to v1.2.0 in game (and reported the proportion bug that v1.2.0 fixed) and confirmed Karin Original v1.0.1 (skirt fix) on their own machine. PicodraTech v1.3.0 and Original v1.0.0 (expressions, the 2026-10 build with DLC) were agent self-tests on a DLC test machine: save load, equipment preview, portrait, physics, expressions, photo mode, talk gestures, walk/jump/attack/crouch; the user has not separately confirmed the expressions. Female human bodies only; male and Beastren bodies keep their look. Cutscenes, climbing large monsters, ladders, ragdoll/death and character editing are unchecked. The portable copies were checked offline only (byte-identical rebuilds, see VALIDATION.md), not in game.
python: 3.10+ (standard library); build_karin_textures.py needs 3.12+ with numpy 2.5 and Pillow; tested 3.14.0
dependency_install: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r portable-kits/dragons-dogma-2/requirements.txt (from bundle root; only needed for build_karin_textures.py)
